Callout.Name: Vehicle Off the Road - Snowbank
Callout.Message: Vehicle off the road in a snowbank.
Callout.Advisory: Occupants out of the vehicle, no injuries reported.

Script.Line: The snow came in and the next thing is the bank.
The car is fine. I am the one who is cold.
I am not standing in the road. I am standing here next to it.

Lines.Approach: They are out and standing next to it, which is the worst place to stand on that road.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
